thesis: The page is the one-line diagram: a single vertical copper line draws down the page through real electrical symbols, and each symbol is a section where services, tools and proof hang off the line like annotations on an engineer's drawing.

signature.name: One-Line Diagram Trace
signature.summary: A 2px copper vertical rule with electrical symbol nodes at each section boundary; the line draws on scroll and nodes light from chalk to copper as sections enter view.

motion.intro: Photo slides in from right (600ms); copper line draws down from frame to first symbol (700ms); text readable at 0ms reduced motion.
stories: Copper pulse travels to next node on section entry (draw)
Tool annotation box wipes open from line (wipe)
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX(0→1), 200ms ease-out
